passages.quote:
This notice should be read with the merchant shipping (work in fishing convention) regulations 2018, the merchant shipping and fishing vessels (health and safety at work) (employment of young persons) regulations 1998 and with MGN 587 (F). It replaces MSN 1882 (F) Amendment 1.

Annex A and B are separately attached alongside this notice.

Notice to

fishing vessel owners and managers

employers of fishermen

skippers

officers and fishermen
